Senior IT Application & Project Manager for Document Management Applications (m/f/d)

  • Deutsche Pfandbriefbank AG
  • Madrid

Deutsche Pfandbriefbank AG (pbb) is an international specialized commercial bank with over 800 employees from 37 countries. We offer our customers a wide range of financing and investment solutions for the entire real estate value chain. Our goal is to contribute to a more sustainable world of real estate.

For our CIO/COO business area based in Madrid, we are currently seeking to hire, with immediate effect, a

Senior IT Application & Project Manager for Document Management Applications (m/f/d)

Your tasks

  • You are responsible for the operational and technical management of pbbs Document Management Applications (e.g. ELO) with a strong focus on project and process management
  • You ensure the application stability, security, performance, maintenance and compliance with internal standards in coordination with the software provider and relevant stakeholders (business units, compliance, information security)
  • You coordinate projects and participate actively in new initiatives regarding the applications you are responsible for
  • You manage incidents, vulnerabilities, changes, upgrades and releases in coordination with the software providers and relevant stakeholders
  • You drive continuous improvement by identifying optimization opportunities and implementing sustainable solutions

How to convince us

  • Minimum 7 years of proven experience in Application Management, Application Support, or IT Operations, as well as IT Project Management, ideally in the financial services industry
  • Proven experience with databases (Oracle, MSSQL), SQL, Windows/Linux Server and role-based access control concepts
  • Experience with IT Processes (e.g. ITIL)
  • Experience with ELO or comparable Document Management Applications is a plus
  • Excellent communication, analytical and problem-solving skills, with fluent English and the ability to work independently in an international environment
  • Willingness to travel within EU from time to time
  • Knowledge of the German Language is an advantage 

Our values

We live our values and expect the same attitude from our employees. Together, we are future-oriented, reliable, and collaborative. 

What you can expect


With us, you will encounter a sustainable corporate culture, diverse and challenging projects, as well as plenty of creative freedom and flexibility. 

And what else?

  • Compelling compensation & great benefits
  • Family-friendly working conditions with at least two days remote working
  • Attractive, easy-to-reach locations 

Sounds exciting? 

So let's shape the future of real estate together. Apply now to join #teampbb in just a few clicks!
